name: Mashimo Saaya
source:
A childhood friend of Gakuto. She is shy and timid, but she only cares about Gakuto. She loves Gakuto and listens to everything he says. 

However, she hates to show her true face, and will never show it to Gakuto, even if he asks her to. 

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_203.html#character]official site[/url]]
